business_model.claim: Amneal is a diversified, global biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes essential medicines, operating principally in the U.S., India, and Ireland.
quotes: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (the "Company", "we," "us," or "our") is a diversified, global biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes a diverse portfolio of essential medicines.
We operate principally in the United States ("U.S."), India, and Ireland.

business_model.claim: Amneal reports three segments: Affordable Medicines (retail generics, injectables, biosimilars), Specialty (branded CNS and endocrine pharmaceuticals), and AvKARE (pharmaceutical distribution to U.S. federal government, retail, and institutional markets).
quotes: We have three reportable segments: Affordable Medicines, Specialty, and AvKARE.

Our Affordable Medicines segment includes retail generics, injectables, and biosimilars. In our Specialty segment, we offer a portfolio of branded pharmaceuticals focused primarily on central nervous system and endocrine disorders. Through our AvKARE segment, we are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and other products for the U.S. federal government, retail, and institutional markets.

business_model.claim: The Affordable Medicines segment includes over 280 product families and generated $1,745,524 (table in thousands) of net revenue in fiscal 2025, up 3.6% year-over-year.
quotes: Our Affordable Medicines segment includes over 280 product families in the United States covering an extensive range of dosage forms and delivery systems

Affordable Medicines net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased 3.6% as compared to the prior year, primarily due to new products launched in 2025 and 2024, which contributed $122.6 million of year-over-year growth, and strong volume growth, partially offset by price erosion.

business_model.claim: The Specialty segment generated $528,508 (table in thousands) of net revenue in fiscal 2025, up 18.6%, driven primarily by CREXONT and UNITHROID growth.
quotes: Specialty net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased 18.6% as compared to the prior year, primarily driven by increases of $58.1 million and $23.7 million of CREXONT® and UNITHROID®, respectively, and growth in our non-promoted products.

business_model.claim: The AvKARE segment generated $744,728 (table in thousands) of net revenue in fiscal 2025, up 12.3%, primarily from growth in the government label channel serving DoD and VA.
quotes: Our AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals primarily to governmental agencies, predominantly focused on serving the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

AvKARE net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased 12.3% as compared to the prior year primarily driven by growth in our government label channel resulting from new product introductions, partially offset by a decline in our lower margin distribution channel.

business_model.claim: Four wholesale and retail customers (Cencora, McKesson, Cardinal Health, CVS Health) accounted for approximately 71% of total net sales in 2025, creating significant customer concentration risk.
quotes: Our four largest customers, Cencora, Inc., McKesson Drug Co., Cardinal Health, Inc. and CVS Health Corporation, accounted for approximately 71%, 70% and 70% of total net sales of products for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

business_model.claim: Consolidated net revenue for fiscal 2025 was $3,018,760 (table in thousands), an 8.0% increase over 2024, with Q3 2026 net revenue of $863 million up 10% year-over-year.
quotes: Net revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $863 million, an increase of 10% compared to $785 million in the third quarter of 2025.

business_model.claim: Gross profit margin for Q2 2026 was 42.0%, up from 39.5% in the prior-year period, driven by lower amortization expense and operating leverage from higher sales volume.
quotes: Gross profit as a percentage of net revenue increased to 42.0% for the three months ended June 30, 2026 from 39.5% in the prior year period primarily due to lower amortization expense and operating leverage from higher sales volume.

business_model.claim: COGS for fiscal 2025 increased 7.4% due to higher sales volume, $22.8 million in impairment charges for non-promoted products, and increased plant and freight costs, partially offset by manufacturing efficiencies.
quotes: Cost of goods sold increased 7.4% for the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the prior year. The increase in cost of goods sold was primarily due to increased sales volume from all segments, impairment charges related to non-promoted products of $22.8 million, and increased plant and freight costs, partially offset by manufacturing efficiencies.

business_model.claim: Competitive entry by generic manufacturers and authorized generics causes rapid revenue and margin decline for existing products; in 2025, Amneal lost exclusivity for RYTARY and an authorized generic was launched.
quotes: As our competitors introduce their own generic equivalents of our generic drug products, our revenues and gross margin from such products generally decline, often rapidly.
In 2025, we lost exclusivity for RYTARY®, an extended-release oral capsule formulation of carbidopa-levodopa for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

business_model.claim: U.S. Section 232 tariffs announced May 2026 impose up to 100% tariffs on certain branded FDF and API, while a July 2026 preliminary proposal would keep generic drugs tariff-free through July 31, 2028 before tariffs rise to 100% for one year and 200% thereafter.
quotes: On May 13, 2026, the President announced the findings of a Section 232 investigation into pharmaceutical imports and the imposition of tariffs on certain FDF and API, under which certain branded pharmaceutical products and their APIs are subject to tariffs of up to 100%, with the potential for tariff reductions and various product-, company-, and country-specific exceptions.

On July 21, 2026, the President announced a preliminary proposal that generic drugs imported into the U.S. would remain subject to no tariffs through July 31, 2028, after which tariffs would increase to 100% for one year and 200% thereafter.

quotes: On April 21, 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of the outstanding membership interests in Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (a related party, as described in Note 18. Related Party Transactions in this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q and Note 22. Related Party Transactions in our 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K) ("Kashiv") in a transaction (the "Transaction") with consideration that includes $375 million of cash and 28,942,108 shares of Class A common stock of the Company at closing, subject to certain purchase price adjustments for cash, and the funding of operations between signing and closing, among others. material_events.claim: Pfizer, after acquiring Metsera on November 13, 2025, exercised its change-in-control rights to shorten the Metsera collaboration agreement term from seven years to four years from first commercial sale, eliminating Amneal's rebate and construction cost reimbursement obligations.
quotes: On November 13, 2025, Metsera was acquired by Pfizer Inc.

On January 30, 2026, Pfizer exercised its rights under the agreement's change-in-control provision to shorten the agreement's term from seven years to four years from the date of first commercial sale.
As a result, the Company's rebate and construction cost reimbursement obligations described above have been eliminated.

material_events.claim: The FDA issued a Warning Letter to Amneal's manufacturing facility in Gujarat, India, following an inspection classified as Official Action Indicated.
quotes: In August 2025, the FDA issued a Warning Letter to our manufacturing facility in Gujarat, India, following an inspection that identified certain deficiencies.
The inspection has been classified as Official Action Indicated.

material_events.claim: The President announced findings of a Section 232 investigation into pharmaceutical imports, imposing tariffs of up to 100% on certain branded FDF and API; generic and biosimilar products and their APIs were exempted.
quotes: On May 13, 2026, the President announced the findings of a Section 232 investigation into pharmaceutical imports and the imposition of tariffs on certain FDF and API, under which certain branded pharmaceutical products and their APIs are subject to tariffs of up to 100%, with the potential for tariff reductions and various product-, company-, and country-specific exceptions.
Generic and biosimilar products, as well as their associated APIs, were exempted from this action.

material_events.claim: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled that President Trump's IEEPA tariffs exceeded presidential authority, invalidating the tariffs imposed thereunder to date.
quotes: On February 20, 2026, the Supreme Court of the United States issued an opinion ruling that President Trump's tariffs exceeded presidential authority under the IEEPA, which had the effect of invalidating the tariffs imposed thereunder to date.

material_events.claim: President Trump imposed a 10% global tariff for 150 days under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974; FDF and API were exempt as of the 10-K filing date.
quotes: On February 20, 2026, President Trump imposed a 10% global tariff for 150 days under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974. FDF and API are exempt from the Section 122 tariff as of the date of this filing.

material_events.claim: President Trump signed the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), which reduced Amneal's current income tax liabilities by $7.8 million during the year ended December 31, 2025.
quotes: On July 4, 2025, President Trump signed OBBBA, which includes a broad range of tax reform provisions affecting businesses, including, but not limited to, extending or making permanent certain business and international tax measures initially established under the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and eliminating the requirement to capitalize and amortize U.S.-based research and experimental expenditures over five years, making these expenditures fully deductible in the period incurred.
These provisions resulted in a reduction of the Company's current income tax liabilities of $7.8 million during the year ended December 31, 2025.

material_events.claim: The President announced a preliminary proposal that generic drugs imported into the U.S. would remain tariff-free through July 31, 2028, after which tariffs would increase to 100% for one year and 200% thereafter; the policy had not been formally implemented as of the 10-Q filing.
quotes: On July 21, 2026, the President announced a preliminary proposal that generic drugs imported into the U.S. would remain subject to no tariffs through July 31, 2028, after which tariffs would increase to 100% for one year and 200% thereafter.

As of the date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, the announced policy has not been formally implemented and significant uncertainties remain regarding its scope, including the treatment of APIs, biosimilars, global supply chains and potential exemptions.
